items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor is unavailable with no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded reversible growth. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, permit only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries, and continue the existing read-only evidence matrix. Do not retrieve credentials, change permissions, access private containers, exploit targets, add dependencies, deploy, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix and failed-work containment only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release and deployment provenance, dependency controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests or new production work.
